items.label: Models cut in price in August

components.title: September's play: finance and insurance perks

rows.label: Tesla: cash off
rows.text: Up to RMB 10k off stock cars, then up to RMB 7k off from Sep 25

rows.label: Xiaomi: 0% or insurance
rows.text: SU7 and YU7: 3-year 0% finance or a RMB 6k insurance subsidy

rows.label: Leapmotor: perks
rows.text: Purchase perks worth up to RMB 19,680

footnote: Source: CPCA price-cut tracking (Jul 6, Sep 8, 2026), Tesla China, China Daily, Yicai Global (Sep 2026)
notes: CPCA's own phrase is fewer cuts, deeper cuts. Fewer models were marked down, but discounted NEVs came down by RMB 45,000 on average, or 17.8%, against RMB 30,000 and 12% in the first half. In September carmakers stopped cutting list prices and switched to time-limited cash, 0% finance and insurance subsidies. CPCA secretary general Cui Dongshu sees this as a short push for the peak season rather than a new all-out price war. Our own deals should move the same way, but only if each one clears the pricing rules, which the rules page explains.
